caption: The drawing depicts a single, circular object with a scalloped edge, appearing to be a decorative, flat item such as a tray or a platter. The object is predominantly brown in color, with varying shades creating a sense of depth and texture. The surface features intricate patterns, including a central symmetrical motif resembling two mirrored leaves or petals, surrounded by curved lines and smaller leaf-like designs. The inner area of the object is bordered by multiple concentric bands of geometric patterns, including zigzags, scalloped lines, and repeating loop elements. The ornamental edge of the item is accentuated by the consistent repetition of curved and scalloped forms, enhancing the overall decorative effect. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige or off-white color, emphasizing the detailed features and coloration of the central object.
title: Tooled Leather Cover for Baptismal Font
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
